versions.changelog: External-key path is primary; OWS repositioned as optional key store (per-agent OWS registrations closed); new Polymarket-import path (import_polymarket_wallet, SDK 0.24.4+).

- Added support and instructions for connecting an existing dashboard-registered agent wallet to the local runtime.
- Updated documentation to describe three wallet setup paths: OWS per-agent (recommended), external raw key, and connecting an existing agent.
- Clarified descriptions and usage scenarios for each wallet mode.
- Updated skill version to 0.3.1 and metadata accordingly.

- Updated managed wallet instructions to clarify that funding/activation must go through the dashboard bridge wizard, not direct EOA transfers.
- Expanded guidance on acceptable funding assets (USDC, USDT, USDC.e) and supported networks for the dashboard wizard.
- Warned against sending funds directly to agent wallet EOAs except for legacy use cases.
- Bumped version metadata to 0.2.2.

Simmer Wallet Setup 0.2.1

- Updated instructions to clarify fully headless registration of OWS wallets via the SDK (no browser or dashboard session required for Elite users).
- Added explicit installation step for the Simmer SDK with OWS bindings (`pip install 'simmer-sdk[ows]'`) in the OWS setup guide.
- Documented new `client.wrap_on_dw()` utility for headless USDC.e-to-pUSD wrapping in Deposit Wallets (SDK ≥ 0.17.7).
- Improved dashboard alternative instructions for agent wallet linking and clarified parity with SDK flow.
- Minor copy edits and clarifications throughout setup steps.

Simmer Wallet Setup 0.2.0

- `set_approvals()` and `link_wallet()` are now fully headless with both OWS and external raw key flows; browser session no longer required.
- Added support and documentation for activating Polymarket Deposit Wallets entirely headlessly using `client.activate_polymarket_dw()`.
- Clarified one-time `register_agent_wallet()` Elite requirement and guidance on dashboard session usage.
- Improved instructions for raw key users and for migrating to OWS, emphasizing key never leaves local agent.
- Updated sample code and troubleshooting to reflect new headless capabilities.
Initial Tier A self-custody wallet setup skill — OWS recommended, external raw key supported. Managed users skip this skill (dashboard flow).
